entities.name: Dekella
entities.description: Legendary bident formed from Nyx, originally owned by Thassa, that lets its wielder command the sea.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: God of the Sea on Theros who owned Dekella.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: Created Dekella and gifted Thassa a replacement.

entities.name: Solon
entities.description: Scholar rejected by the goddess when attempting to steal the bident.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: Planeswalker who took Dekella from Theros; later wounded by Kozilek.

entities.name: Arixmethes
entities.description: Massive kraken Kiora tried to win over.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: Eldrazi who awoke and wounded Kiora.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: Found wounded Kiora and helped retrieve the bident.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: Planeswalker who touched Dekella hoping to copy its powers.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Conflict in which trapped planeswalkers met Ravnican leaders.

events.summary: Kiora traveled to Theros claiming to be Callaphe, was thought to be Thassa, and escaped with the bident after a fight.
events.quote: the planeswalker escaped with the bident

events.summary: Kozilek awoke and greatly wounded Kiora; Jori En found her and they retrieved the bident.
events.quote: Kozilek awoke and greatly wounded Kiora.

events.summary: Dack Fayden touched Dekella hoping to copy its powers; Kiora caught him.
events.quote: Dack Fayden managed to touch Dekella

relations.quote: Dekella was created by Purphoros and used by Thassa on Theros
